title: Semantic element mutation and conflict branching
summary: Semantic edits operate on exact semantic object revisions, not whole files. dev28 proposes immutable object revisions and uses the existing sparse branch authority when the submitted base is stale.
invariants: source.propose_edit requires an existing semantic object and exact base revision.
SOURCE_UNIT and SOURCE_FILE are not accepted as whole-file mutation targets.
A non-conflicting edit creates a PROPOSED revision; accepted_revision_id changes only through explicit acceptance.
A stale-base edit leaves the current pointer unchanged and retains both candidates in a CONFLICT branch.
An unresolved conflict never silently changes ordinary materialisation.
Caller identity comes from the authenticated session; request-body identity is not authority.
Source Editor remains projection tooling; SSC/Development Desk remains semantic revision authority.
